task.description:
Implement ISS-207, ISS-208, ISS-205 on branch feature/WF02-iss207-208-205-20260611. Follow design docs exactly.

ISS-207 (src/engine/instance.zig, src/dlq/store.zig, src/api/routes/dlq.zig):
- retry: check instance has changed cause (new def version or correction event); reject bare retry with 409+hint
- retry-with-input: re-present trigger with operator payload
- discard: set instance CANCELLED

ISS-208 (src/tasks/store.zig, src/api/routes/tasks.zig):
- In complete(): SELECT instance status FOR UPDATE inside the same transaction
- If not ACTIVE: return 409, no events appended

ISS-205 (src/webhook/dispatcher.zig, route handlers that emit events):
- Insert matching webhook_deliveries rows in the same DB transaction as the event
- Worker pool: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED on (status=PENDING, next_attempt_at <= now())
- Back-off: 5s,30s,2m,10m,30m; after 5 failures: pause subscription + emit OBS-06 alert
- Startup sweep also uses SKIP LOCKED (defence in depth)

After all three: zig build && zig build test && zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set' (empty). Commit.
acceptance_criteria: ISS-207: bare retry rejected 409+hint; retry-with-input advances; discard cancels
ISS-208: complete() returns 409 for non-ACTIVE instance, enforced in transaction
ISS-205: webhook_deliveries inserted in same tx as event; SKIP LOCKED worker; back-off ladder

result.summary: Implemented ISS-207 (DLQ retry convergence), ISS-208 (task completion guard), ISS-205 (webhook transactional outbox). Build: 0. Tests: 0.
